relations.subject: Luciano Petech
relations.evidence: He was a student of the Italian explorer, academic, and scholar Giuseppe Tucci.

relations.subject: Luciano Petech
relations.evidence: Petech began his teaching career in India at 25 years old, as a reader in Italian at the University of Allahabad from 1938 to 1946.

relations.subject: Luciano Petech
relations.evidence: Petech returned to Europe in 1947, to temporary teaching appointments at the Istituto Orientale of Naples and University of Rome.

relations.role: Chair of History of Eastern Asia

relations.subject: Elena De Rossi Filibeck
